selection_rule: Deterministic, frozen before the single run: (1) reuse cached upstream fetch runs/mind2web_import/raw.json (300 tasks, hud-evals mirror, fetched 2026-07-10); (2) apply the same committed exclusion filters as tools/import_mind2web.py (EXCLUDED_DOMAINS + login-text regex); (3) remove the 20 source_task_ids in data/browser_eval/external/mind2web_subset.json; (4) counts = official upstream level distribution 81/141/78 -> largest remainder for n=20 = easy 5 / medium 10 / hard 5; (5) per level take FIRST-N by ascending source_task_id with per_domain_cap=2 within this file. No task-text inspection, no manual picks.
anti_overfitting_protocol: HELD-OUT SINGLE RUN. Results reported as-is. Looking at results and then modifying agent/verifier followed by a rerun on this set is FORBIDDEN. --resume only on harness interruption, never to redo done tasks.
